dataset.name: NEU-DET
dataset.selection_rule: all tracked flattened validation images: crazing 240..300 and every other class 241..300
dataset.source_class_semantics: filename prefix is not ground truth; each YOLO label may contain multiple classes
dataset.cache_policy: read image and label paths from this manifest; do not read data/labels/val.cache

evaluation.label_format: YOLO normalized class_id center_x center_y width height
evaluation.ground_truth_policy: count every YOLO TXT box; VOC difficult/truncated flags are not represented

integrity.image_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of raw image file bytes
integrity.label_hash_semantics: decode UTF-8, normalize CRLF and CR to LF, preserve all other text bytes, then SHA-256
